verdict.rationale: Asana's own docs mention a native Rules feature: rule actions, app components built on rules, and a PagerDuty integration that fires automatically from tasks via Rules. AI Studio is also marketed as no-code automation. The evidence is thin marketing-level mention, though, with no documentation of the trigger/event model, conditions or rule configuration. Missing for 10: documented event triggers and conditions for rules, rule-builder documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Automate tedious work in powerful, bespoke ways with our platform features like rule actions, webhooks, and our API.
Automatically create PagerDuty incidents with context from Asana tasks using Rules.
Build app components on the surface of tasks or rules
